label: Search decision
title: A small relational language for discovering necessary distinctions
summary: Myk accepted a bounded Prolog grammar and exact witness-verification pilot, with optional Jev ranking confined to equal-cost candidates. Datalog and predicate invention are deferred.
takeaway: Separate candidate vocabulary, search order and exact verification; a learned score cannot certify or prune a candidate.

label: Search pilot
title: A failed prediction can constrain the next description
summary: On the known finite Rule-24 repair, exact witness reuse reduces full verifier calls from 278 to 11 and recorded median search time from 0.686 to 0.409 seconds, retaining the same optimum. Jev was not evaluated.
takeaway: A concrete conflict can force a distinction that has no immediate greedy gain. This one-case result supports witness reuse, not a general Prolog or AI advantage.
